notes: New course: Electronics & Microcontrollers, written for the Elegoo MEGA 2560 starter kit: 84 lessons from "what is electricity" to registers, interrupts and plain AVR C
Every build lesson has a checked wiring diagram with a pin-by-pin table, the full sketch, what you should see, troubleshooting, challenges and a quiz, plus a "tested on real hardware" box to tick
Seven capstone projects with your kit: parking sensor, motion alarm, plant water monitor, IR remote fan, weather station, tilt maze game and an RFID door lock

The simulator now runs Mega sketches with the kit's parts: shift registers, 7-segment and matrix displays, the LCD, the real-time clock, the motion sensor, RFID cards, the IR remote, the keypad and more
New in the Workshop: the Electronics Bench, with calculators for LED resistors, Ohm's law, resistor colour codes and voltage dividers using your kit's resistors
New in the Workshop: My Parts. Tick the parts you own and see which lessons and projects you can build right now
